description: This file contains Kotlin functions related to diagnostics and status reporting for the OpenClaw Android application, specifically dealing with gateway diagnostics, status interpretation, and user interface interaction such as copying diagnostic reports to clipboard.

methods.name: openClawAndroidVersionLabel
methods.description: Returns a string label representing the app version, appending '-dev' if in debug mode and not already labeled as a dev version.

methods.name: gatewayStatusForDisplay
methods.description: Returns a trimmed version of statusText, defaulting to 'Offline' if empty.

methods.name: gatewayStatusHasDiagnostics
methods.description: Determines if the gateway status indicates diagnostics are available (not offline or connecting).

methods.name: gatewayStatusLooksLikePairing
methods.description: Checks if the gateway status text suggests pairing or approval process based on key terms.

methods.name: buildGatewayDiagnosticsReport
methods.description: Generates a detailed diagnostic report string for troubleshooting gateway connection issues, including device info, Android version, gateway address, status, and instructions.

methods.name: copyGatewayDiagnosticsReport
methods.description: Copies the generated diagnostic report to clipboard and shows a toast notification.
